description: Returns a hosted checkout_url for an exact product and selected fulfillment mode using the delivery address. JENNi selects the source internally. The buyer reviews delivery, tax and the total, enters payment details, and places the order on the hosted page. This read-only tool creates no order, reservation or charge. The final checkout page verifies current price and availability.

delivery_address.description: Delivery destination. Address details are not placed in the checkout URL.

fulfillment_mode.description: Selected fulfillment mode: local_delivery arrives on the delivery date the buying-options read returns (delivery_promise / deliver_by); ship_to_home ships to the delivery address.

product_id.description: The exact item: a variant's product_id when it has variants.

name: start_checkout

delivery_promise.description: Local delivery: "Get it today" or "We'll deliver by <Month D>". Ship-to-home: "Ships to you".

pricing.description: unit_price x quantity + fee = total_before_tax. Sales tax is added at checkout.

fee.description: Local delivery fee or flat shipping.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason, alongside the prose note.
Machine-readable reason, alongside the prose note.

title: Start checkout
